tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark is the default (Movie night); light is Sunday morning.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Nav bars, sidebars, panels, menus, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, poster plates (missing artwork), list rows.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on surfaces (web), skeleton highlight.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, the 1px edge that keeps a white poster from dissolving. Decorative.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: fields, radios, checkboxes (non-text contrast).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body, nav. Every ground, and over scrims.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, synopsis, secondary lines. Body-safe (APCA Lc 75+) on bg-base, bg-raised and surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, labels only (Lc 60+). Never body text.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The amber thread: the one action color. Primary button, selected tab underline, played timeline, progress.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill (dark Lc 75, light Lc 82).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 4px, 3px offset, never removed. Same amber as the action.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals. Scrims over artwork are separate light-falloff gradients (README).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon (transcoding, low disk), always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info text and icon, always with a word or icon.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Detail page title on web and iPad (serif), 2 lines max.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Detail title on phone, hero on web (serif).

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Missing-artwork plate title, profile picker (serif). Smallest serif size.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Page headers on phone and web (Library, Settings), onboarding steps.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Row titles, panel titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Card titles, list row titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Synopsis on detail, onboarding body.
styles.sample: A woman is suspected of her husband’s murder.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body, metadata on web.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary lines, chat, helper text. Never below 13px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav, menu items.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Small buttons, list labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags (4K, HDR10, CC), section labels. Uppercase only here.

styles.name: tv-title-xl
styles.usage: Hero and detail title (serif), 2 lines max.

styles.name: tv-title-l
styles.usage: Detail title when the hero is shorter; profile picker headline (serif).

styles.name: tv-title-s
styles.usage: Title on a missing-artwork poster plate (serif). Smallest serif size anywhere.

styles.name: tv-heading-l
styles.usage: Page headers (Settings, Search).

styles.name: tv-heading
styles.usage: Row titles.

styles.name: tv-heading-s
styles.usage: Focused card title under a poster.

styles.name: tv-body
styles.usage: Synopsis, panel rows.
styles.sample: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends.

styles.name: tv-label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav, chips.

styles.name: tv-body-s
styles.usage: Metadata lines.

styles.name: tv-caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, hints, tags. Nothing on TV is smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, tag gaps, button gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card gap on phone, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone margin, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between posters on web.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Web gutter, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between posters on TV, row spacing on web.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row spacing on TV.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Detail page left margin on web, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: TV safe area, horizontal (5% of 1920).

tokens.name: space-tv-safe-y
tokens.usage: TV safe area, vertical (5% of 1080).

radius.note: One scale tied to size: small things slightly rounded, large surfaces nearly square. Full rounding only where the shape means something.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, progress bars, timeline segments.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Posters, landscape cards, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, toasts, skip button.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Panels, menus, dialogs, cards on phone.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of phone bottom sheets (platform convention). Nothing larger exists.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only avatars, toggle tracks, radio dots and the timeline thumb.

shadow.note: Few and warm. Light comes from the focused element, not from cards.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, panels, toasts, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus on TV and keyboard: 3px ground gap, 4px amber ring, warm glow below. Combine with the focus scale.

duration.note: Fewer, slower, purposeful. Frame-by-frame specs in the README.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover color change (web).

tokens.name: duration-focus
tokens.usage: Focus move on TV: scale, ring, glow, sibling dim.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, menus, sheets, toasts in.

tokens.name: duration-controls
tokens.usage: Player controls fade out.

tokens.name: duration-backdrop
tokens.usage: Hero backdrop crossfade after focus settles.

tokens.name: delay-backdrop
tokens.usage: Wait before the backdrop follows focus, so fast scrolling does not flicker.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that moves into place. No overshoot anywhere.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Crossfades and the controls fade.

tokens.name: scale-focus-card
tokens.usage: Focused poster or landscape card on TV.

tokens.name: scale-focus-control
tokens.usage: Focused button or chip on TV. Keyboard focus on web does not scale.

tokens.name: scale-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed.

tokens.name: brightness-unfocused
tokens.usage: Siblings in the row that holds focus (CSS filter brightness).
